My interest in Nvision Insight Group Inc., an Indigenous management consulting firm based in Ottawa, Ontario has been placed in a trust. 
The trust was established as authorized by the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, under section 19 of the Code, to entrust my interest in a private corporation that is a party to contracts with the Government of Canada. The trust was not established for political reasons and I am ordered by the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, as required by paragraph 41.3 (1) b) of the Parliament of Canada Act, not to derive any income from it, including the distribution of assets on its termination, for the purpose of financing a nomination contest, a leadership contest or an electoral campaign.
